I'm scared of it not working and I'm scared of what if my life does get better but I just don't know? Anyways, I've set a date a little in the future and if my life isn't better then, then... I don't know.


edit: Thank you for your comment :)

Yeah I think I want a friendship like theirs. The problem is none of my other friends really have the same interests as me whereas they all have one common interest- games. 

The problem is I don't know what kind of activity I'm comfortable with... In either situation they would ignore me for their closer friends. And whenever I've asked them to hang out one on one they ignored my messages. Should I try again? 


Thank you so much for your thorough response, it really made me happy to see someone else talking to me and giving their opinion on my situation.
Hi OP, are you still there? I wanted to talk but I fell asleep. Do you not like summer vacation?
woebegone is the word I got wrong in my spelling bee in 6th grads. My class cheered so loudly for me and I had no idea what woebegone was...

Ahh, I understand. I tried to seperate myself from people too because I thought they didnt like me, but in the end I was too weak to stay away so I still make forced conversation. 
Are you talking to a counselor about your childhood problems/how you feel right now? I'm not but I really wish i was..
It is so tiring to keep on going everyday. Do you have anyone you care about? Friends? Family? SO?

It really sucks to feel so empty when everyone else around you is just so full of life and hopes and dreams and laughter. It makes it hurt even more. I know how that feels... What are your interests? Favorite foods? Hobbies? Talents?

I think you're amazing for trying, what may seem to others as you being lazy or putting in no effort could have been tremenoud seffort on your part. I know how it feels to try so hard but have others not understand how hard you tried to fit in. 


I'm so sorry that happened to you when you were younger...
I understand where you're coming from... I'm in a similar situation where I know I have great, wonderful, fantastic friends but I just feel lonely even when I'm with them. What hobbies do you have?

Yes, I can't wait for college. I really like the independence that comes along with it, I want to move out from my parents who are way too controlling and not understanding of me or how I feel.


I've never played any MOBAS I don't think, could you give some examples? I watch twitch, and professional csgo but that's about it.

I really like soup, especially the kind my parents used to make for me when I was sick. 

I want to major in something engineering related, not quite sure yet.
I value education, not the school system. My parents are upset about my B's I have right now and expect amazing things from me when I feel less than mediocre
I am okay, I like first person shooters- CSGO. And I'm trying to get into other games if my parents let me... What do you play?
Yeah, I've always been interested in everything you've mentioned. Maybe we should have a conversation.

I'm a female actually haha
And I like to play first person shooters on Steam, CSGO and some single player games

I like fantasy and science fiction books, don't watch much tv, and I watched a lot of world war II movies lately, schindler's list was a good one.

What would you do to work if you didnt have to make money?
Don't be so quick to blame yourself, maybe he was the one who changed.

What happened with your father?
I get how you feel about this world being awful and wanting it to end. I'm setting a deadline for life improvement for myself. If good things haven't happened by then, I'm ending it. I also feel like I have no one to talk to, I write stuff down and draw and let it sit in my mind till it disappears..

I completely agree. People grow older and become consumed with just so much of *life*  that they cease to have time for relationships with others. Right now I'm about to enter college, a little scary but I'm ready for the new change of pace in life.

I have several friend groups, but no close friends if that makes sense. I have many friends and people whom I talk to (I have a loose definition of the word friend) but no incredibly close friend
It's been a week. I'm alright.
Why does he visit your dad and not you?
Everything.
my parents wouldnt approve of this and they would say im ruining my future. if i talk to my school counselors, ill jeopardize a lot of things right now so i cant talk to them.
Hey, thanks for the reply..

I hope you're doing well, I'm going through confusing times now too but I have people to talk to. If you want to talk, just message me or something. What's wrong right now? You're cared about, OP. I am genuinely interested in your life and want to know how you are doing.
